    Frequently asked questions about our plans

    Can I change plans?

    Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade at any time with 30 days notice.

    What does "pausing" mean?

    If you have a quieter period, you freeze the subscription and the remaining days are saved for when you reactivate it.

    Is there a minimum commitment?

    No. Cancel with 30 days notice, no penalties.

    How does 48h delivery work?

    Each request you start has a 48 business-hour delivery window from when we accept it. Complex projects are broken into milestones, each with its own 48h cycle.
